description: The closed vocabulary for a LEAD's industry, decided during enrichment. Exactly one of `industries[].industry` may be stored on a contact, VERBATIM — same case, same '&', same commas. This file is the single source of truth: the Go bridge validates against it and the enrichment playbook instructs from it, so the two cannot drift. Do not copy the list into a playbook, a prompt, or a second file.

not_to_be_confused_with.client_industry: The CLIENT's own industry/sub_industry in the Client Intelligence Profile is a different field on a different record, set once at onboarding. A lead's industry is per lead.
not_to_be_confused_with.leadup_proposal_industries: LeadUp's proposal API has its own 10-value remote taxonomy at https://leadupteam.com/plans/templates/industries.json, used only when creating a proposal. It is finer-grained in finance and law and coarser everywhere else; the two lists do NOT map one-to-one and neither is derived from the other.
not_to_be_confused_with.source_registry_industry: source_registry.go's Industry is a search-pool cache key, not a lead attribute.
not_to_be_confused_with.collector_industry_hint: gql_extract.js industryHint() is a 14-value keyword regex on a search row. It is not this vocabulary and must never be written into this field.

selection_policy.who_decides: The ENRICHMENT AGENT, by reading the signals the collector returned. Never a keyword map in code. Two regex classifiers already in this codebase show why: gql_extract.js `category` recognises only real-estate and insurance wording, and industryHint() knows 14 trades — every other job is invisible to both, and a live profile whose only trade signal was 'NMLS #2509012' would have been classified by neither.
signals_to_read: the profile's own bio and intro lines (people who work for a living say so)
a licence or credential number — NMLS, DRE, CPA, bar number — which names a regulated trade outright and outranks self-description
the email and website DOMAIN (reachhomeloans.com, williamsaverealestate.com)
the value under a Work heading, which carries a JOB TITLE; the employer alone is often ambiguous
Facebook's own `category` when present, as corroboration only — it is blank on roughly a third of profiles and is not authoritative
selection_policy.do_not_read: Posts. A person's trade is published on their profile; reading their feed to infer it costs many times the tokens for a weaker signal.
rules: Read the actual services, credentials, employer and stated audience. Do not classify from a single ambiguous keyword.

Compare against every entry's positive_signals AND exclusions before choosing. The exclusions exist because 16 pairs in this list overlap; skipping them is how the same lead gets two different answers on two runs.
When two entries are genuinely co-equal, prefer the one naming the REGULATED trade the person is licensed for. A licence is a fact about them; a self-description is a claim.
Store the value character for character as written in `industry`. Not lowercased, not 'and' for '&', not singularised.

When no entry fits, or the signals are too thin to choose, leave industry EMPTY and say why in reason. An empty industry is a lead that still gets worked; a wrong one silently mis-targets every message after it.
Never infer an industry from a person's name, language, location or profile photo.
selection_policy.record_shape: enrichment.identity.industry (the value), .industry_confidence (0-1), .industry_reason (one sentence), .industry_signals (the quoted lines it was decided from)

positive_signals: licensed agent, Realtor or broker representing buyers, sellers, investors or landlords
primary work is listing, showing, buying or selling property
a DRE / state real estate licence number
exclusions: a mortgage loan officer or lender, even one who works with the same buyers -> Loan & Mortgage
a property and casualty insurance agent -> Insurance
a real estate attorney with no brokerage practice -> Legal
a stager, photographer or interior designer serving agents -> Home Improvement & Interior Design

positive_signals: originates, brokers or advises on mortgages, refinances or consumer loans
an NMLS number, which is the licence for a mortgage loan originator and names the trade outright
exclusions: a realtor who merely refers clients to a lender -> Real Estate
a retail bank teller or branch employee not originating loans -> Banking & Financial
commercial debt advisory with no consumer lending -> Banking & Financial

positive_signals: banking, wealth management, retirement or general financial planning
a bank, credit union, or a fiduciary advisory practice
exclusions: mortgage origination -> Loan & Mortgage
selling life or health insurance policies -> Insurance
tax preparation, bookkeeping or IRS representation -> Tax, Accounting, Bookkeeping
brokerage of stocks or crypto as the primary business -> Stock & Cryptocurrencies

positive_signals: sells or advises on insurance of any kind — life, health, Medicare, auto, home, commercial
a licensed insurance agent or agency
exclusions: a financial advisor whose practice is investments, where insurance is incidental -> Banking & Financial
a public adjuster or restoration contractor -> Construction & Building

positive_signals: trading, brokerage, education or advisory centred on equities, derivatives or digital assets
exclusions: general retirement and wealth planning -> Banking & Financial

positive_signals: tax preparation or planning, bookkeeping, audit, payroll, or IRS representation
a CPA licence or EA enrolment
exclusions: investment or retirement advice as the primary practice -> Banking & Financial
tax law practised by an attorney -> Legal

positive_signals: practises law or provides legal services
a bar admission or law-firm affiliation
exclusions: an immigration practice, whether or not run by an attorney -> Immigration
a workforce-export or overseas-placement agency -> Work Abroad & Immigration
notary or document-preparation services with no legal practice -> Office Supplies & Equipment

positive_signals: visas, residency, citizenship, asylum or family petitions for people already choosing a destination
exclusions: recruiting or placing workers into jobs abroad -> Work Abroad & Immigration
placing students into schools abroad -> Study Abroad & International Education
general legal practice where immigration is one of many areas -> Legal

positive_signals: recruits, trains or places workers into JOBS in another country, visa handling included
exclusions: visa and residency work with no job placement -> Immigration
placing students into schools -> Study Abroad & International Education
domestic staffing and recruitment -> Information Technology & Services

positive_signals: places students into schools or universities in another country, including student visas and applications
exclusions: job placement abroad -> Work Abroad & Immigration
domestic tutoring, courses or online learning -> Education & eLearning

positive_signals: teaches, tutors, or sells courses and training, in person or online, within one country
exclusions: sending students abroad -> Study Abroad & International Education
childcare and preschool -> Childcare & Parenting
fitness or nutrition coaching -> Sports & Fitness & Wellness

positive_signals: diagnoses or treats patients, or operates a clinical facility
a medical, dental or nursing licence
exclusions: dispensing or manufacturing drugs -> Pharmaceuticals
gyms, personal training and nutrition -> Sports & Fitness & Wellness
aesthetic treatments with no clinical practice -> Spa & Cosmetics

positive_signals: dispenses, distributes or manufactures medicines
exclusions: clinical treatment of patients -> Healthcare & Hospitals
supplements and wellness products sold as consumer goods -> Sports & Fitness & Wellness

positive_signals: training, sport, nutrition or wellness coaching
exclusions: massage, facials, nails or aesthetic treatment -> Spa & Cosmetics
clinical physiotherapy inside a medical practice -> Healthcare & Hospitals

positive_signals: beauty, skincare, hair, nails, massage or aesthetic treatments, or sells cosmetics
exclusions: fitness and nutrition coaching -> Sports & Fitness & Wellness
a physician-run practice where treatment is clinical -> Healthcare & Hospitals

positive_signals: builds, renovates or performs licensed trade work — roofing, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, concrete
exclusions: decorating, staging or furnishing without construction work -> Home Improvement & Interior Design
selling the finished property -> Real Estate
manufacturing building products in a factory -> Manufacturing & Industrial

positive_signals: designs, decorates, stages, furnishes or landscapes homes
exclusions: structural or licensed trade work -> Construction & Building
selling appliances -> Household Appliances
selling the property itself -> Real Estate

positive_signals: sells, repairs, services or details vehicles
exclusions: auto INSURANCE -> Insurance
auto loans and financing as the primary business -> Loan & Mortgage
freight and trucking operations -> Transportation

positive_signals: moves people or goods as the service itself — driving, hauling, shuttling
exclusions: freight forwarding, warehousing, customs or supply-chain coordination -> Logistics & Supply Chain
tour operators selling travel experiences -> Travel & Tourism
vehicle sales or repair -> Automotive Sales & Services

positive_signals: coordinates freight, warehousing, customs, procurement or fulfilment
exclusions: operating the vehicles that carry the goods -> Transportation

positive_signals: sells or operates travel — tours, flights, hotels, packages, destination experiences
exclusions: providing the transport itself as a standalone service -> Transportation
student or work placement abroad -> Study Abroad & International Education or Work Abroad & Immigration

positive_signals: prepares or serves food and drink, or runs ordering, delivery or review for them
exclusions: selling packaged groceries -> Grocery & Supermarket
growing or raising the food -> Agriculture & Farming
event catering sold as part of a wedding package -> Events & Wedding Services

positive_signals: retails packaged and fresh groceries
exclusions: preparing and serving meals -> Restaurants & Food Ordering & Review
farming or wholesale produce -> Agriculture & Farming

positive_signals: grows crops, raises livestock, or supplies farming inputs and equipment
exclusions: retailing the produce to consumers -> Grocery & Supermarket

positive_signals: manufactures, fabricates or processes goods at scale, or supplies industrial equipment
exclusions: building on site -> Construction & Building
handmade or small-batch craft goods -> Art & Crafts

positive_signals: supplies or installs power, water, gas, solar or energy services
exclusions: electrical contracting inside buildings -> Construction & Building

positive_signals: builds or services software, IT infrastructure, websites or technical systems, including consulting and staffing for them
exclusions: selling devices to consumers -> Consumer Electronics
network operators -> Telecommunications
marketing services delivered through software -> Marketing & Advertising

positive_signals: operates or resells telecom networks, mobile plans or internet service

positive_signals: retails or repairs phones, computers and consumer gadgets

software and IT services -> Information Technology & Services

positive_signals: retails or services large home appliances
exclusions: phones, laptops and small gadgets -> Consumer Electronics
HVAC installation as a trade -> Construction & Building

positive_signals: sells marketing, advertising, branding, PR or content services to other businesses
exclusions: producing entertainment or publishing media as the product -> Entertainment & Media
software products sold to marketers -> Information Technology & Services

positive_signals: produces or distributes entertainment or media as the product itself

photography as a service -> Art & Crafts

positive_signals: designs, makes or retails clothing, footwear or accessories
exclusions: watches and jewellery -> Watches & Jewelry
cosmetics and skincare -> Spa & Cosmetics

positive_signals: sells or makes jewellery, watches or precious metals

positive_signals: sells flowers, gifts or occasion items
exclusions: planning the event itself -> Events & Wedding Services

positive_signals: plans, hosts or supplies weddings and events end to end
exclusions: selling flowers or gifts without planning -> Gifts & Flowers
catering as a standalone restaurant business -> Restaurants & Food Ordering & Review

positive_signals: creates or sells art, handmade goods, photography or craft work
exclusions: factory production -> Manufacturing & Industrial
media produced for broadcast or publishing -> Entertainment & Media

positive_signals: treats, grooms, boards, trains or supplies animals
exclusions: livestock and farm animals -> Agriculture & Farming

positive_signals: cares for young children or supports parents

positive_signals: provides physical security, monitoring, alarms or safety services

positive_signals: retails books, stationery or school supplies
exclusions: publishing as a media business -> Entertainment & Media

positive_signals: supplies or services office equipment, furniture and consumables
